description:
Two related perf/correctness items:

1. **Registry scoping**. `OctoPi.TUI.Events` Registry uses
   topic atoms `:stdin_chunk` and `:resize` that are VM-global.
   Two concurrent `Interactive.run/1` calls register against
   the same topics and see each other's events. Either:
   - Scope topics per-session: `{:stdin_chunk, session_id}`.
     Terminal takes a session_id on start_link and broadcasts
     under the scoped topic.
   - Or document that Interactive is single-run-per-VM and
     guard it (return :error if already running).

   Prefer scoping — supports future use-cases (multi-terminal
   session, tests running in parallel).

2. **Render memoization**. `Interactive.render_frame/3`
   computes `render/1` which calls `Components.Input.render/2`,
   then `cursor_position/2` calls `Components.Input.render/2`
   AGAIN to count its lines. Cache the result — one call per
   frame. Keep `render/1` pure; pass the cached input lines
   into both consumers.

TDD:
- Two concurrent Interactive runs → each only sees its own
  events (integration test with two sessions).
- Input render call count is 1 per frame (inject a test
  Components.Input that counts calls, or use :counters).
title: Events Registry per-session scoping + Interactive render memoization
